;Arts and culture
*[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] and [[First Lady of the United States|First Lady]] [[Melania Trump]] make an unannounced post-Christmas visit to troops at the [[Al Asad Airbase]] in [[Iraq]], their first visit to a combat zone since taking office. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-46687909 (BBC)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/trump-visits-us-troops-in-iraq-for-first-trip-to-a-conflict-zone/2018/12/26/d3f7d272-055e-11e9-b5df-5d3874f1ac36_story.html?utm_term=.013e2c844d37 (''The Washington Post'')]
*After a 53-day trek, [[United States|American]] professional endurance athlete [[Colin O'Brady]] allegedly becomes the first person to cross [[Antarctica]] alone and unaided; his claim of being unaided has been disputed, and the first person to really cross Antarctica alone and unaided was [[Børge Ousland]] in 1996 and 1997. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-46687892 (BBC)]
